messages:
jesse (sales): Quick heads-up — Prospect (AcmeBank) wants a short POC to validate BYOK + HSM tunneling for inference encryption. They specifically asked: 1) pricing for HSM-backed key ops (per-request) + dedicated capacity uplift, 2) rotation windows and who signs/owns the ceremony, 3) answers for a security questionnaire about key attestations. Can we scope?

sam_solutions: For scope, we need a few bits: expected QPS to KMS (roughly per-token key unwraps?), whether they want envelope encryption or direct wrap/unwarp per request, and if they require KMIP vs Cloud HSM APIs. Also: do they need attestation docs (FIPS/FedRAMP) or just HSM audit logs?

priya_sec: Short answers: we can provide HSM attestation artifacts (vendor certs) and SOC2 controls mapping. For their questionnaire, ask if they require customer-supplied HSM (BYOK on their HSM) or Redwood-managed HSM with CMK export disabled. Rotation: we support customer-triggered rotation windows and automatic scheduled rotations; for high-security customers we run manual ceremony support.

marco_engops: A couple of engineering flags: network egress to customer HSM (if they host) -> firewall rules/ports and MTU/latency matters. If using per-request unwrap on path, expect extra p50 latency ~6-20ms depending on HSM location. We can offer a key-proxy to cache wrapping keys and reduce round trips. Example config we typically ask for:```
kms_provider: customer-hsm
endpoint: hsm.acmebank.corp:5696
auth: mutual_tls
key_id: projects/acme/keys/llm-wrap-01
wrap_mode: envelope
cache_ttl_ms: 5000
```

jesse (sales): Nice. Pricing question from procurement: do we bill HSM requests as add-on per 10k unwraps + a small % on token usage? They want an order-of-magnitude before the SOW. Also they asked if rotation support is included or a separate professional services line.

sam_solutions: Typical offer: 1) Dedicated HSM tunneling add-on: $X/month per HSM instance (replace X with quote bucket) + $Y per 10k unwraps. 2) Dedicated inference capacity (if they want reserved GPUs) billed separately. Rotation ceremony support: usually a one-time PS block (est 8-16 engineer-hours) + runbook delivery; we can roll it into an annual support add-on for enterprise. I'll pull exact numbers from the pricing playbook and paste.

priya_sec: For the questionnaire, ask them to close these items: a) Do they require HSM key exportability? (we do not export CMKs), b) SIEM integration — do they want KMS audit events forwarded to their tenant? We support log forwarding via syslog/Cloud Logging; c) Key custody: single vs split custody requirements? d) Rotation RTO/RPO expectations.

marco_engops: Ops blockers to call out to customer: open outbound to our control-plane IPs for attestation checks, TLS mutual-auth cert exchange, and if they plan to use low-latency unwrap per token we need to validate throughput on their HSM or set up a local proxy. Also include perf test vectors: 10k unwraps over 5 minutes, 99th percentile latency target.

jesse (sales): Action items — Sam, can you draft a short quote + PS estimate for rotation ceremony? Priya, can you assemble a short answers doc for their questionnaire (SOC2 mapping, attestation PDFs, non-export policy)? Marco, can you list firewall/IPs and perf test vectors we can send to their infra team? I'll package all into an email to procurement.

sam_solutions: Yep — I'll drop a draft by EOD and include two pricing tiers (managed HSM vs customer-hosted tunnel).

priya_sec: I'll attach the attestation pack and a template Qs/As. Also suggest we require an explicit statement if they want daily rotations (that will need automation + PS).

marco_engops: I'll put together the perf checklist and the minimal network rules. Also propose a quick 30-min integration call with their infra + our eng next Tue.

security-bot: Reminder: attach latest FIPS/SOC2 attestation pdf (s3://internal-sec/attestations/2025-redwood-hsm.pdf). :paperclip:

jesse (sales): Perfect — thanks all. I'll set the call and ping the customer with draft timeline: 3wk staging + 1wk perf + rotation dry-run. :thumbsup:
